content: The team applies a model based on SGNS with vector initialization alignment and cosine distance (SGNS + VI + CD). Vector initialization is an alignment strategy where the vector space learning model for $t_2$ is initialized with the vectors from $t_1$ BIBREF19. Since SGNS + VI + OP does not perform as well as other models in BIBREF0, they alter the vector initialization process by initializing on the complete model instead of only the word matrix of $t_1$ to receive improved results.
